messages:
jamie (People Ops): Thanks everyone for joining — posting the hiring/org recap here. Drop follow-ups about headcount, timing, or team changes and we’ll respond live.

mike (Eng): quick q — infra manager hires: Q2 or Q3? need to know for interviews.

ashley (CTO): good question. managers are targeted for Q3; we want 2 senior ICs in infra in Q2 to reduce bus factor first. managers follow the headcount cadence.

lucy (Recruiting): recruiters: we currently have 6 open reqs for infra/product across EMEA & US; interview loops ready for 4 of them. ping me for candidate funnels.

sarah (Hiring Manager): will those manager slots be net new or internal promotions? affects backfills.

jamie (People Ops): net headcount plan for FY is +25. estimate ~10 promotions/transfers, so ~15 net-new hires. managers counted as net new if externally hired.

dave (Product): prioritization ask — should we push for product PMs now or focus infra latency hires?

ashley (CTO): prioritize infra latency hires for Q2 to hit latency SLOs; product PMs are high priority too but some can wait til later in quarter.

mike (Eng): noted — thanks. one more: any update on hiring budget approvals for Dedicated infra?

jamie (People Ops): budget approved at leadership level for Q2 hiring runway. recruiting to start outreach next week.

lucy (Recruiting): scheduling kickoff with hiring managers today. will share candidate scorecards template in #devex. :thumbsup:

mike (Eng): awesome, thanks all.

all-hands-bot: Reminder — recording + slides uploaded to #all-hands-resources.
